### The Power of Prayer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/power-of-prayer
Passage: Isaiah 38:4-6
Points:
- God's promises are given not to foster passivity, but to encourage believers to pray fervently.
- Hezekiah's recovery demonstrates that prayer has genuine power before our sovereign Creator.
- God truly interacts with His people in time, hearing their prayers and seeing their tears.
- Even though the Lord already knows how He will answer, believers must continue interceding for themselves and others.

### Bible Pathways - August 8, 2005
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-august-8-2005-1343598.html
Passage: Isaiah 38:1
Points:
- Believers should never hesitate to pray, no matter how hopeless a situation appears.
- When facing imminent death, Hezekiah poured out his tears and appealed to a life lived faithfully before God.
- The Lord graciously responded to Hezekiah's sincere prayer by adding fifteen years to his life.
- Christians should reject feelings of unworthiness fueled by Satan and trust God’s grace to answer fervent prayer.
